summary: preinstall script downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods it into a temp directory, and then invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped inside the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line JavaScript bundle using string-array-shift obfuscation (`WV8StW` rotator + numeric string-array), with no human-readable strings and no references from anything under `dist/`. Its sole invocation path is the preinstall Bun exec. The alternate-runtime dispatch bypasses Node-oriented supply-chain scanners, and the executed payload's contents are not inspectable. The advertised purpose of the package is a React component library — dist/ contains a normal React build — and requires no native code, no build step, and no second language runtime; `package.json` also lists neither `setup.mjs` nor `math_init.js` in its `files` field, and carries empty `author`, empty `description`, and no `repository`/`homepage`, all consistent with a grafted install-time dropper on the `@servicetitan` scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
